conversation.purpose: Long-form transcript; 15px at widths up to 620px.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: History and inspector drawers; ordinary surfaces stay flat.

motion.name: button-state
motion.value: background .15s ease, color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Transition and animation duration under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary empty-state action
components.description: Existing text action for starting with an AI-selected topic.
components.html: <button class="preview-primary" type="button">Để AI tự chọn chủ đề</button>
components.css: .preview-primary { font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--text, #ececec); color: #171717; box-shadow: none; transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .preview-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ffffff; } .preview-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #ececec); outline-offset: 3px; } .preview-primary:disabled { opacity: .42; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .preview-primary { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Settings field
components.description: Neutral input with visible hover and keyboard focus.
components.html: <input class="preview-field" aria-label="Chủ đề" placeholder="Nhập chủ đề" />
components.css: .preview-field { font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #383838); border-radius: 8px; background: #242424; color: var(--text, #ececec); box-shadow: none; } .preview-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #ababab); opacity: 1; } .preview-field:hover { background: #292929; border-color: var(--stroke-strong, #575757); } .preview-field:focus, .preview-field:focus-visible { border-color: #a0a0a0; outline: 1px solid #a0a0a0; box-shadow: none; }

narrative.overview: Neutral charcoal, a darker sidebar, restrained controls and a readable transcript for personal desktop entertainment. Typography and spacing carry the hierarchy; decoration stays quiet.
dos: Do reuse existing neutral tokens and vanilla components.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and readable metadata.
donts: Don't add gradients, neon decoration or icons.
Don't add dependencies or features for styling.
